title: Krea AI review: pricing, API & alternatives
summary: A current Krea AI review covering real-time creation, image and video models, app versus API billing, Krea 2 licensing, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
Quick Answer


## Quick answer


Krea is best for creators who value rapid visual iteration, real-time image workflows, enhancement and access to several image and video models in one interface. Its API is a separate prepaid product, and Krea 2 downloadable weights have a separate community license. Evaluate the app, API and open model as three distinct buying decisions.


This is a documentation-based review, not a controlled quality benchmark. We checked Krea's official product, API, business and Krea 2 licensing pages on September 18, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative.


## What is Krea AI?


Krea is a generative creative platform for image and video workflows, including rapid generation, editing, enhancement, nodes and access to multiple third-party models. It also publishes Krea 2, its own downloadable image model, and offers a separate API product.


Do not confuse Krea with KreadoAI, an unrelated avatar-video product. Search results and comparison articles sometimes mix the names, which produces inaccurate feature and pricing claims.


## Why creators choose Krea


Krea's differentiator is iteration speed. Its real-time creation surfaces let users steer an image while adjusting prompts and visual inputs, which is useful for art direction and exploration. Node workflows extend that approach into reusable image and video pipelines.


A fast interface is most valuable when it shortens decision time. Test whether the workflow produces an approved asset faster, not merely more variations. For brand work, inspect text, logos, product geometry and color consistency before accepting an output.


## Krea app pricing and API billing are separate


Krea's[official API page](https://www.krea.ai/features/api) says app plans may include web-app compute, while API calls use a separately funded prepaid balance. API prices are dollar-denominated per successful generation, tracked in microdollars, and failed or cancelled jobs are not charged. Jobs are asynchronous and can be polled or delivered by webhook.


The page lists models from providers such as Flux, Google, Kling, Runway and others, with output-based prices that vary by model. Use the exact endpoint page at implementation time because catalog names, versions, latency estimates and prices change.


## Krea 2 hosted access versus open weights


Krea 2 is available through Krea's hosted products and as downloadable Raw and Turbo weights. Those routes are not governed by one universal license. The[Krea 2 Community License](https://www.krea.ai/krea-2-licensing) permits commercial use below a stated annual company-revenue threshold of $1 million; companies above it need an enterprise license. Hosted app and API use follow their own terms.


If you deploy the weights, preserve the license version, attribution and model files you used. If you call a hosted endpoint, use the hosted service's current commercial and data terms instead of assuming the community license controls the API.


## Business use, ownership and privacy


Krea's business terms say business customers own their inputs and outputs and receive commercial rights, and that business data is not used for model training. Confirm that your account is actually covered by those business terms. Individual plans, third-party models and downloadable weights can carry different conditions.


## Who should choose Krea?


Krea fits designers and creative teams that benefit from visual exploration, real-time steering, enhancement and switching among current models. It is also relevant for developers who want one asynchronous API for several image, video and enhancement models.


Compare alternatives when you need structured presenter videos, deep timeline editing, a single model at maximum volume, or a workflow whose auditability matters more than rapid exploration.


## Krea versus Magic Hour


Krea emphasizes real-time visual iteration, nodes, enhancement and a curated model API. Magic Hour emphasizes direct product workflows across image, video, audio, face swap, lip sync and talking photos, plus APIs for common tasks. Compare the same brief in the[Magic Hour AI image editor](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-editor) and consult the[best AI image editors guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/the-best-ai-image-editors) for category context.


### Test an edit with your own source


Use an image with real text, edges and identity details, then compare instruction following, repair time and export quality.


[Try AI Image Editor](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-editor)


## A fair Krea evaluation


Run three tasks: a new image from text, a controlled edit of an existing image and a short video from a reference. Keep the inputs and acceptance criteria constant. Record model, settings, attempts, elapsed time, charged amount and manual corrections.


For API work, test queue submission, webhook verification, idempotency, cancellation, error responses, retention and cost reconciliation. A playground success is not enough to prove production reliability.


## Verdict


Krea is a strong option when real-time feedback and flexible model access materially accelerate creative direction. The key is to separate three products: the creative app, prepaid API and Krea 2 weights. Compare each under its own price and license before choosing.
